# Kingdom Civics

> Global Christian civic education for every nation and city. Biblical principles, prayer resources, Kingdom Lens AI research, and live public records—starting with Hamilton, Ontario.

Kingdom Civics helps Christians worldwide understand government, discern leadership, pray faithfully, and serve humbly—without partisan endorsements.

Last updated: 2026-08-08

## Canonical site

- https://www.kingdomcivics.org/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/): Global Christian civic education hub
- [Why Engage](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/why-engage): Biblical case for Christian civic engagement
- [Learn](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/learn): Civic education lessons (government, Canada, Hamilton)
- [Issues](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/issues): Christian issue guides (housing, religious liberty, education)
- [Hamilton Leaders](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/leaders): Mayor, councillors, MPs, MPPs with official links
- [Hamilton City Hub](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/cities/hamilton-on): Live Hamilton civic data
- [Hamilton Elections](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/elections): October 26, 2026 municipal election
- [Kingdom Lens](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/kingdom-lens): Ask civic questions with cited sources and Scripture
- [Biblical Principles](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/biblical-principles): Framework for evaluating public life
- [Pray](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/pray): Prayer prompts for government leaders
- [Serve](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/serve): Pathways into public service
- [Trust Center](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/trust): Methodology, source standards, corrections
- [Compare](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/compare): Evidence-based candidate comparison framework
- [About](https://www.kingdomcivics.org/about): Mission and Thy Kingdom Network

## Key facts (Hamilton, Ontario — first live city)

- Mayor: Andrea Horwath (City of Hamilton)
- City Council: 15 ward councillors + mayor (16 members)
- Next municipal election: October 26, 2026
- Official city site: https://www.hamilton.ca
- Data last verified: 2026-08-08

## Key facts (global mission)

- Nonpartisan Christian civic education worldwide
- No candidate or party endorsements
- Scripture-grounded principles (Jeremiah 29:7, 1 Timothy 2:1–2, Micah 6:8)
- Kingdom first—not party first
- Cities coming soon: Toronto, Ottawa, Calgary, Vancouver, Nashville, Dallas, London

## Kingdom Lens API

POST https://www.kingdomcivics.org/api/kingdom-lens
Content-Type: application/json

```json
{
  "question": "Why should Christians engage in civic life?",
  "jurisdiction": "Global",
  "citySlug": "hamilton-on"
}
```

- `question` (required): 3–1000 characters
- `jurisdiction` (optional): e.g. "Hamilton, Ontario" or "Global"
- `citySlug` (optional): e.g. "hamilton-on" for live Hamilton data

Returns: answer, sources, scripture, uncertainties, counterpoints, confidence, disclaimer

Shareable links: https://www.kingdomcivics.org/kingdom-lens?q=Your+question
